heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. When you join a clinic, confirm who is the custodian of the records you create and whether a data-sharing agreement is in place ([BCCNM documentation FAQ](https://bccnm.ca/NP/learning/documentation/Pages/Default.aspx)).
2. Check your charting against the [BCCNM Documentation standard](https://www.bccnm.ca/NP/PracticeStandards/Pages/documentation.aspx) and [MSP's clinical record requirements](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/assets/gov/health/practitioner-pro/medical-services-plan/4_clinical_record_documentation_nov2024.pdf).
3. For a privacy breach or a records request you're unsure about, call [CNPS](https://cnps.ca/services/plp-core/) or ask [BCCNM Standards Support](https://public.bccnm.ca/standardssupport).

heading: How to Do It in Ontario
title:
1. When you join a clinic, confirm who is the health information custodian under [PHIPA](https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/04p03) for the records you create, and what the custodian's policies require.
2. Chart to the [CNO Documentation standard](https://www.cno.org/Assets/CNO/Documents/Standard-and-Learning/Practice-Standards/41001_documentation.pdf) and handle personal health information as the [CNO privacy standard](https://www.cno.org/Assets/CNO/Documents/Standard-and-Learning/Practice-Standards/41069_privacy.pdf) sets out.
3. For virtual visits, follow the [CNO Virtual Care guideline](https://www.cno.org/Assets/CNO/Documents/Standard-and-Learning/Practice-Standards/practice-guideline-virtual-care-en.pdf).
